content.description: Retro Quake-era seamless textures, mostly 128x128 (some 64x64): dirt and gravel ground, stone-brick walls, slate and tile floors, metal grates and riveted panels, wood planks and doors, top-down barrels, window frames, fabric, fences, and ornate banners/tapestries. Supplied in both a Quake palette and true-colour version. Dark industrial-fantasy mood with muted browns, greys and mossy greens. Best for retro FPS/dungeon level construction, 3D blockouts, or tile-based pixel scenes.
